text: I am an army officer in the Dominican Republic in 1961. For decades now, my country has been governed by a dictator who has had thousands of people killed because of their ethnicity or their political views. I am a member of a group that wants a new start for my country without a civil war. To achieve this goal, I consider it unavoidable to torture the dictator in order to disempower him. If I and my accomplices do this, he will be forced to end his regime. If I do not do it, the regime will continue to kill a thousand people this year.
